body.summary: S003 task9 adds private session/root/revision SDK resources with existing revision gates, guarded callbacks and late-work retention; branded frozen access resolves only through live original authority before saved lookup. Automatic activation follows atomic registration, activation retry preserves revision, and new driver drains are awaited on end/shutdown with safe closed handles retained. Seven new real-socket/SQLite cases plus 64 focused regressions/inventory checks and build pass. SDK quiet proof, analyzer integration and full expiry matrix remain later tasks; release remains disabled.
